name: A circle of charity
source:
The fall semester at UofX, 2003.
Two graduate students gather to speak with an angel girl.
Meanwhile, the ties that bind three women tighten and twist.
Only files remain. Trace your fingers around the circle carefully.

[From [url=https://bagenzo.itch.io/charity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2003年，X大学的秋季学期。
两名研究生相聚，与一位天使女孩交谈。
与此同时，连结三个女人的纽带，正逐渐收紧、扭曲。
最终，只剩下文件。小心地用手指，沿着这个圆追寻痕迹。

[摘自[url=https://bagenzo.itch.io/charity]itch.io[/url]]
